1.bug_scenario: When you run CriticalRequestChains.extractChain on a set of network records that include an <iframe> document (and its children), the iframe and its sub‐resources show up in the “critical” request chain even though iframes aren’t render‐blocking resources. In Lighthouse’s current implementation you’ll see a root node (your page), then an iframe node (resourceType “iframe” or “Document”), then its CSS/JS children — exactly as shown in the PaulIrish.com screenshot.
